answer: The inlet debit happens at intake, lotus totals the burned amount, and oasis anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 6 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm hence pays the burn once for each alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. A 308 account operation therefore ties up 29 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
